project.name: 玄学图鉴
project.designRead: showcase website / culture lovers & divination curious / mysterious luxury oriental / medium-low density / avoid neon cyberpunk or cheap red-gold fortune-teller clichés

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: deep night blue-black #0A0A1A base, ancient gold #C9A961 accent, cinnabar red #B83B3B for alerts

typographySystem.display: 'Noto Serif SC', serif for Chinese titles; 'Cormorant Garamond', serif for English accent
typographySystem.body: 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif for Chinese body text

styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceModel: border-led cards on dark surface, no heavy shadows except floating layers
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeLanguage: angular refined, gold borders, ink-wash gradients

pages.title: 首页
pages.visualNorthStar: Starry night sky background with ink-wash gradients, golden typography glow, ceremonial ritual feel

continuityAnchors.header: sticky top nav with gold logo + nav links

imagePlan.features: no extra images, use icons + gold borders

pages.soulElement: Hero section features animated star field with ink-wash gradient overlay and gold calligraphy title with subtle glow pulse

pages.title: 玄学地图
pages.visualNorthStar: Interactive knowledge tree visualization with three track views, node cards with heritage status badges
pages.soulElement: Each knowledge node shows heritage status with color-coded pills (active=endangered=severe=lost) and tool availability badges

pages.title: 流派详情
pages.visualNorthStar: Four-section article layout with source tracing, historical figures, modern perspective, and heritage status

continuityAnchors.sectionHeaders: gold left-border accent with serif headings

pages.soulElement: Article sections use subtle ink-wash watercolor background variations and gold-bordered classic book references
